name: io.github.xmtlzzz/dsh-any-agent
description: Drive DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as a long-lived, resumable coding agent from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to @deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js. Leave unset to auto-detect the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, an npm global install, or the npx cache.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_MCP_PERMISSION
environmentVariables.description: Default permission tier for dsh_start: read-only, workspace-write, or danger-full-access (setting it as the default allows full access on this machine; asking for it per conversation under another default also needs DSH_MCP_ALLOW_FULL_ACCESS=1).

environmentVariables.name: DSH_MCP_APPROVAL
environmentVariables.description: Machine-side approval ceiling for sandbox escalation: auto-deny, ask, or auto-allow. The default workspace-write tier denies escalation. Read-only always denies.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_MCP_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language of the tool descriptions and server instructions: en or zh. Unset follows the system locale.
